chunks: Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali (peace be upon him) assigned us to Abi Basir.

So I said to him: 'How can I know who loves me and who hates me?' He said: 'As for the one who loves you, he supplicates for you with good; and as for the one who hates you, he supplicates for you with evil.'

key_terms.أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ: Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali (Imam al-Baqir)

ai.seo_question: How to distinguish between friends and enemies based on their prayers?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records this insight from Imam al-Baqir (AS) to provide a practical criterion for distinguishing sincere adherents from hypocrites based on the content of their *du'a*. This method highlights the spiritual principle that the heart's inclination naturally manifests in one's petitions, serving as a reliable indicator of true love (*mawaddah*) or enmity (*bu'd*) towards the Imam.
